risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (214.4) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event today adds binary risk, and earnings in 17 days create additional volatility catalyst for energy sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + stochastic + MACD bullish alignment provides technical confluence for mean-reversion entry near support (26.06) with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis conditions (VIX 214.4, inverted yield curve, NFP event today), high earnings risk in 17 days, weak ADX trend strength, low volume confirmation, and overbought Williams %R create compounding headwinds that overwhelm technical signals.
